2609.08452.title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
2609.08452.paper_summary: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate one training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed workflows across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons. Optimization diagnostics further characterize its stability under different event reductions and set sizes.
2609.08452.paper_summary_zh: 多代理大型語言模型透過協調多個政策在共享環境中解決複雜任務。<lb/>然而，現有的強化學習方法通常分別優化每個回應或軌跡，即使幾個輸出共同導致一個狀態轉換。<lb/>因此，更新單元與系統執行的動作不同。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SRPO（集合相對政策優化），它將活動集合視為由一次轉換消耗的最小輸出集合，作為一個多代理動作。<lb/>具體而言，SRPO將成員對數比結合成一個基數正規化的集合比率，分配一個相對優勢，並一次性裁剪該集合。<lb/>這個公式將分工和聯合共同演化統一為具有不同集合大小的動作。<lb/>在數學推理和多輪搜索的實驗中，展示了一個針對固定、混合和動態路由工作流程的訓練介面，涵蓋四個模型規模，在報告的比較中獲得了最強的宏觀平均結果。<lb/>優化診斷進一步描述了其在不同事件減少和集合大小下的穩定性。
